{{Quote|You seem to think I personally run this war, Doctor. Believe me, if I did, it'd be run a sight better.|Hotise|<ref name="Death Star (novel)">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Hotise''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a medical [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the commander of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[MedStar Four]]''. He was a short, rotund man and wore a cropped beard. Dr [[Kornell Divini]] was under Hotise's command for a short time prior to Divini's assignment to the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].

Hotise eventually transferred to the Death Star himself where he assumed command of the [[N-One Medcenter]] and once again became Dr Divini's superior. He was presumably killed onboard the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
